label: Per se necessary esse in SCG I.22, modal proxy versus dependence sense
term: per se necessary (SCG I.22 n.3 'per se necesse')
resolution: PER_SE_NECESSARY_1 (NecessaryEsseAt, with ContingentConjunctionAt for a non-necessary joining) is the modal proxy used by the first-case results of PR #1602. PER_SE_NECESSARY_2 (PerSeNecessaryEsseAt, with DependentConjunctionAt) is the dependence sense, of which only the per se (non per aliud) component is encoded: the esse exists and has no cause of its necessity other than itself, with no necessity component proper; and a joining that depends on something. The batch's coverage and second-case premises quantify over every joined pair of distinct principles, while n.2 and n.4 speak only of the per se necessary esse; the results apply them only there. Every argument of the Chapter22SecondCase batch uses PER_SE_NECESSARY_2 only; the #1602 arguments use PER_SE_NECESSARY_1 only. No argument passes from one sense to the other, and no bridge between them is asserted: the finite control essenceDependentProfile has a joining that is dependent but not modally contingent, so the modal proxy does not capture n.3's own dependent case.
